About

I don't just find spaces. I see what they're about to become.

Over a decade in retail real estate, the experience-driven kind: the fitness, hospitality, and F&B brands people actually leave the house for. I've closed 315+ transactions across 27 states and DC, built and led high-volume site-selection teams, and scaled a national franchise platform from 13 to 135+ signed leases. Today I'm VP of Real Estate at STRONG Pilates, an Australian reformer concept expanding across the U.S. and 18+ countries, which gives me a live read on where the entire experiential category wants to be. Paquin Capital is my personal investment vehicle, taking passive positions in real estate assets across the U.S. and select international markets. Licensed Georgia broker. Cornell Real Estate Council. Based in Atlanta, GA, USA. Building what's next in experiential real estate.

What I Do

The work

Site Selection & Market Strategy

Market planning, trade-area analysis, and site selection for retail and experiential brands, matching the right concept to the right corner across corporate and franchise territories.

Lease Strategy & Deal Execution

LOI and lease negotiation, landlord and broker relationships, and deal execution end to end. 315+ transactions closed across 27 states and DC.

Development & Investment

Development pipeline execution and construction handoff for ground-up and retail projects. Paquin Capital, my personal investment vehicle, takes passive positions in real estate assets across the U.S. and select international markets.

Franchise Real Estate Systems

Scalable real estate infrastructure for high-growth franchise platforms. Scaled one national platform from 13 to 135+ signed leases and built global tracking and test-fit systems from scratch.

Featured Project

Paquin Park

Home base, headquarters, and hospitality proving ground.

Paquin Park is a Paquin Capital project on a 1.02-acre property in Brookhaven, Atlanta. It is two things at once: my home base and headquarters, the place I run everything from, and a living proof-of-concept for the experience-driven hospitality work I advise on, where the thesis gets tested on my own ground. Inspired by my family's transformation of Paquin Farms into a hospitality destination, it carries that approach into one of Atlanta's most sought-after neighborhoods.

Junior Real Estate Manager  ·  2014–2017
Heritage

Where it all started — and the man who built it

“

Before there were deals, there was the farm.

My father built Paquin Farms from the ground up — hundreds of acres in Edmonson County, Kentucky, carved into something extraordinary through sheer force of vision, grit, and an unrelenting belief that land should be cared for and brought to life. He didn't just build a farm. He built a model for how to steward a place with intention: the fencing ran straight because he cared about the details; the vineyard was planted because he believed in doing something nobody else in the region had done; the log cabin, the gazebo, the pond, the event barn, the welcome center — every structure was a statement about what it means to build something that lasts.

What he instilled in me had nothing to do with real estate as a transaction. It was about land as a living thing — something that deserves respect, long-term thinking, and the courage to invest before anyone else sees the value. That foundation shapes everything I do today: the way I evaluate a site, the way I think about a market, the way I approach a deal not just as an asset but as a place where something real is going to happen.

Every acre I've underwritten, every lease I've negotiated, and every site I've selected carries a little piece of what I learned walking that farm with him.

French Fort Vineyards
Junior Real Estate Manager
Paquin Farms — Edmonson County, KY  ·  2014–2017

Managed real estate operations and land development for Paquin Farms, a multi-use agricultural and events property spanning hundreds of acres in Edmonson County, Kentucky. Responsibilities encompassed land planning with plats and surveys, property management, vendor and contractor coordination, and end-to-end infrastructure development — including road grading, fencing systems, electrical, pond construction, and the build-out of guest cabins, the welcome center, the event barn, and the gazebo. Also handled brokerage activity for adjacent parcels, including the listing and marketing of farm tracts, developing branded signage and listing materials for rural land sales.

Farm + Vineyard Manager
French Fort Vineyards — A Division of Paquin Farms & Paquin LLC  ·  2013–2014

Led all operations of French Fort Vineyards, an estate winery and agritourism destination on the Paquin Farms property. Oversaw vineyard planning and development, winery operations, complete brand identity creation, event programming, and wine business strategy — drawing on Wine Business Management studies at Sonoma State University. Directed brand and marketing efforts from logo design to on-site signage to digital presence. French Fort became a destination for tastings, private events, and farm-to-glass experiences in Kentucky's emerging wine corridor.
